name: cohorts-losses-no-hire
about: Q-AD34: a mature cohort with no hire and losses after conversion, beside young ones; the brief must not invent a qualified count.

output.headline: Regional Class A — Joliet was the only campaign running on November 3, 2026, spending $214.50 for 7 leads at $30.64 each.
points: Regional Class A — Joliet delivered 7 leads from 10,230 impressions and 152 clicks at a 1.5% click rate. It accounts for all of November 2026's spend so far: $214.50 on Meta with 27 days left in the month.
The 2026-10-05 cohort (19 leads) is mature: 15 were contacted, 5 made applicants, 3 applied, and 4 were lost after conversion. None were closed as not qualified and none were hired yet.
The 2026-10-19 cohort has 23 leads and is too young to judge rates. So far 17 were contacted, 6 were made applicants, 2 applied, and 1 was lost after conversion.
The 2026-11-02 cohort has 7 leads and is too young to judge rates. Only 3 have been contacted so far and none have moved further — worth watching to make sure outreach continues.
No lead quality data is available for the 14-day window; the campaign list is empty.
